code: library(LandscapeRGolem) library(dplyr) library(readr) options(shiny.port = 3838)  prepare_data_for_landscaper <- function(data, document_var, date_var, text_var, clean_text_var, colour_var, x_var, y_var,permalink_var, sentiment_var){   data <- data %>%     dplyr::rename(document = {{document_var}},                   date = {{date_var}},                   text = {{text_var}},                   clean_text = {{clean_text_var}},                   cluster = {{colour_var}},                   V1 = {{x_var}},                   V2 = {{y_var}},                   permalink = {{permalink_var}},                   sentiment = {{sentiment_var}})   return(data) }  data <- read_csv(path / to / data)  data <- prepare_data_for_landscaper(data, document, date, text, clean_text, cluster_name, V1, V2, permalink, sentiment)  LandscapeRGolem::run_app_from_other_project(data = data)

title: Render a landscape as an interactive 3D terrain map — ls_plot_terrain
text: Bins set 2D co-ordinates onto fine grid renders 3D terrain, style population density map. bin becomes column whose height follows number documents nearby, dense regions rise peaks sparse regions sit low plains. grouping variable supplied, column coloured groups occupy every group gets label anchored highest peak. output single self-contained HTML file. drawn WebGL browser, needs JavaScript libraries works offline (fonts fall back system fonts internet connection).

title: Render a landscape as an interactive 3D terrain map — ls_plot_terrain
code: ls_plot_terrain(   df,   x_var = V1,   y_var = V2,   group_var = NULL,   text_var = NULL,   bins = NULL,   bandwidth = 1.6,   roughness = 0.25,   height_scale = c("relief", "sqrt", "linear", "log"),   spread = 0.35,   compress_outliers = TRUE,   height_by = c("auto", "count", "density"),   colour_by = c("auto", "group", "enrichment"),   place_names = TRUE,   exaggeration = 1,   land_threshold = 0.2,   colours = NULL,   labels = NULL,   title = NULL,   subtitle = NULL,   caption = NULL,   theme = c("paper", "dark"),   file = NULL,   open = NULL )

title: Render a landscape as an interactive 3D terrain map — ls_plot_terrain
text: df Data frame tibble, one row per document. x_var, y_var Variables holding x y co-ordinates. group_var Optional grouping variable (example cluster topic) used colour label terrain. text_var Optional text variable. One example document per bin shown hover tooltip. bins Number bins along longer axis. Higher values give finer detail. default grows number rows, 200 420. bandwidth Smoothing applied counts, bins. Larger values give rounder hills. roughness 0 1. much fine-grained texture raw counts mixed smoothed surface. height_scale density maps onto height. "relief" (default) sets sea level sparse ground stays flat dense regions rise steeply, tallest peaks softened one large cluster flatten rest. "linear", "sqrt" "log" plain transforms density, lifting low ground last. spread far push groups apart, fraction distance group's centre overall centre. Gives clusters room breathe. Groups mixed together hardly moved. Set 0 keep original co-ordinates. compress_outliers Pull far-flung points groups towards main landmass fills view. Groups moved whole, shape kept. height_by "count" makes peak group's mountain proportional number documents, heights compare topic sizes. "density" uses local density, tight clusters rise higher loose ones size. "auto" (default) uses "count" groups occupy regions, "density" otherwise. colour_by "group" colours bin groups . "enrichment" colours bin group -represented compared overall share, leaves bins close average neutral. suits variables sentiment spread across whole map. "auto" (default) picks "enrichment" groups heavily mixed. place_names text_var supplied, name regions map distinctive words. Finer place names appear zoom , clicking place opens panel keywords example documents. exaggeration Multiplier height peaks. land_threshold Controls far base plate extends around points. Lower values give larger landmass islands around outlying points. colours Optional vector colours groups. Can named group level. labels Optional named character vector rename group labels, example c("1" = "Browser privacy"). title, subtitle, caption Text poster-style header footer. subtitle sits small capitals title. theme "paper" (light) "dark". file Path write HTML . NULL temporary file used. open default (NULL) map returned visibly, opens printed console embedded used R Markdown, Quarto pkgdown article. TRUE opens straight away FALSE writes file; return result invisibly.

title: Render a landscape as an interactive 3D terrain map — ls_plot_terrain
text: browser can drag rotate, shift-drag (right-drag) pan scroll zoom. Hovering column shows documents groups beneath . Clicking group legend isolates . Shift-click adds groups selection. toolbar can flatten map 2D view, rotate slowly download high-resolution PNG. binned summary written file, large data sets (millions rows) produce files roughly size small ones. exception text_var, stores one example document per bin.
